name: How long does water-damaged drywall replacement usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does water-damaged drywall replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for water-damaged drywall replacement varies based on the extent of the damage and the size of the area. A small patch job might take a day or two, including drying times for mud and paint. For larger sections or entire walls, the process could extend to several days, factoring in demolition, drying the underlying structure, new drywall installation, multiple coats of mudding and sanding, and painting. Professional crews can often expedite this process efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing depends on damage size, ranging from a couple of days for small areas to several days for larger replacements.
